newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to launch new UK-made Primera.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to launch new UK-made Primera.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it will launch a remodelled British-made five-door Primera model in Japan.
The new Primera will go on sale February 24 with an annual sales of 250 units.
The selling price will be 2.377 million yen in Tokyo, a Nissan spokeswoman said.

The new Primera, produced by Nissan Motor Manufacturing (UK) Ltd in Sunderland, made a debut in October 1996 in Paris and Nissan had sold 40,000 Primeras, including a four-door version, in Europe by end-January.
Nissan has been selling UK-made five-door Primeras in Japan since October 1991. The previous model had sales averaging 120 units a year in Japan.
